header: How a testimonial wall looks with real content
subheadline: These quotes are examples. They show how the wall handles short and long quotes, names and portraits.

testimonials.quote: We started on the free Community plan and switched the client's site from Forest to Midnight during the review call.

author_image.title: Portrait of Amelie Roux

testimonials.quote: One Agency plan covers all our client sites. Per-page presets carried a multi-brand relaunch, so we retired a second codebase.

author_image.title: Portrait of Emmanuel Mensah
author_image.alternative: A man around sixty with dark skin and short grey hair, wearing a charcoal sweater.

testimonials.quote: Setup took an afternoon: install, seed the styleguide, done.

testimonials.quote: The template audit allows no inline styles and no fixed colours. That is why our handovers got easier.

testimonials.quote: After the editor workshop, most of our editors used the new elements within two weeks.
